t: Quick-drying, low odour powder wood filler can be stained or painted with any type of conventional paint, varnish or stain after 3 hours. No depth limit, 30 minute working time, excellent adhesion and easy to sand. Can also be shaped, drilled and screwed. Suitable for internal and external use on all types of wood, including exotic species, chipboard and plywood. Natural wood colour.
b: For Use on All Wood Types
